note: The one notification plan (task 6, owner 26-27 Nov 2026). src/notify.js and the Worker read it; the owner chat follows it and sends no slot reminders of its own. Times: 'at' = minutes from the reel's slot (negative = before); 'clock' = IST time. Words: {ch} channel, {title} reel title, {slot} its time, {n}/{days} the test day, {time} when it was posted, {ontime} on time or late. Slots always come from design/slots.json; a channel listed there under 'tests' uses the 'test' plan until its 'until' day.
